changed.what: Coupled conditional draws, so paired-boundary (B-only 0.29, A-only 0.24) and the planted gain (0.25, 0.02) are reachable at baseline 0.6; independent arms cannot reach them. Claim parameter held at the world's value. Planted runs sized by the stated rule (n = 121, 153, 194, 225 at i = 1, 2, 5, 10). Reuse-mutant expectation on the paired worlds corrected for the frozen baseline: 0.034 and 0.126, not 0.101 and 0.623. Mutants as N38a-14 nc-<nnnn> branches under MR-13's record; binds mr:MR-13@host; leak control record. e2e uses g0_laws -- KA-622 (KA-622 is G0 in the plan). New tests coin_world_joint_cells and stats_planted_sizing. Dep N38a-16.

Gives a surface for opening and closing campaigns: the admin actions open and close of eval.ledger (CLI flags, MCP action property, their own idempotency key, 803 on conflict; VERBS-ground's form). Output schema is now frob.eval.ledger.out/1, as in VERBS-eval. Adds the claim-family input, predecessor and level_schedule (Bonferroni spend). Adds the battery campaign kind for the U32b request to BD-261. Refusals now use N24-REF's registered symbolic names; qualification-undecided names the refusal of a real family while undecided. Tests added. Round 1's U24c config request verified as applied.

Idempotency conflict named FROB-REF-803, as BD-259 and KA-763 have it. Campaign-state refusals use the registered symbolic names (battery campaign: claim-family-mismatch). 567 covers any caller-named world set, development addresses included. e2e: --idempotency-key replaced by --key, with distinct keys. Tests added for 567 and the symbolic names.

Decision mapping now covers every registered rule: absolute, equivalence and e-process, besides the paired verdicts. Exact test values: f = 1/3/4 of 200 give 0.0275/0.0432/0.0504; d = 0/1/2 of 128 give 0.0284/0.0428/0.0553. The D4 refusal is named 825, a paired D4 arm is 533, and 720, 701 and the symbolic campaign refusals are listed. The >99% control is read on absolute-above; the paired worlds are checked against their expectations.

U24b request applied after checking it. Gate count and control run on synthetic:null-absolute/1 (expected F about 17; control 0.9987). Paired worlds reported beside the gate: 500 campaigns each, exact bound 37. Their control expectations are 0.034 and 0.126, corrected from the request's 0.101 and 0.623 because reuse also freezes the baseline's outcomes. Planted arm sized by rule. 7,000 real-lane campaigns. Script uses the open/close actions, --key per call, and the gauntlet row with MR-13's nc feature.

Registers all four world names: null-absolute, null-pairs, null-boundary and planted-gain. Boundary and planted worlds use the coupled draws. The broken lane is MR-13's nc build, not a driver variant, and this bead binds mr:MR-13@daemon. Control: >99% on the absolute world; paired worlds against their expectation. The stop-and-restart attack is refused with 720. Script uses open/close, keys and the gauntlet row.
Its mutant is now the derivation half of MR-13's nc branch, which N24b-18 writes. N24-REF already lists 886. Close goes through the admin action. Battery campaigns have no key and no family.

--key on run calls; open/close commands on q:e2e-cart/1; preanalyze call given in full; (17, k, 0) glossed as the development addresses; the development-address negative control names FROB-REF-567, with a test.

Its in-tree check is N12-13's sample-coverage checker, so dep N12-13 added (KNOWN_DRIFTS 7). The pre-close bundle has no counts, so its check reports the decision not recomputed; after close it is recomputed. Bundle calls carry distinct --key; close via the admin action.

Rule 9, the pre-close qualification-receipt form: no counts, rules 5, 7 and 8 only, accepted with a note. Counts present on an open campaign are rejected (829). Specimen and mutant added to the corpus; tests and acceptance added.

The M3 lane now runs a full cycle: the owner opens a scratch campaign, the request is committed, the bundle is made before close (e6 without counts), the owner closes, and the re-bundle's bound is recomputed from the revealed counts. Hand e6 marked as the post-close form. The stale VERBS-prove note is replaced, since that row now lists the receipt form at M3. Test l7_e6_pre_close_form added.

Feature `mutants` replaced by gauntlet-mutations,<crate>/nc-<nnnn>, with control records. The path set is BD-261's registry-derived set, not a file. Step 8 corrected: the leak build is caught by N24b-18's receipt-shape assertion; fresh clusters mean it does not push the count above 123. e2e gets open/close commands. Tests added.

U32b request applied: sealed objects of a battery campaign. The seal and read-sealed admin actions are qual:admin only before close, each read is in the ledger, every other read path gives 840, objects enter the fuzz dictionary and static audit, and they are revealed at close. Planted leak uses the nc convention with a control record. Tests and an e2e step added. Round 1's U24c holder request verified as applied.

Real open/close commands with keys, and a check that a repeated open replays. Dry run uses the positional design with --key. 803 named in step 4. New step 5a ledger_invariants for N24c-09: ten requests, 0.05*10/11. 567 now also covers development addresses. Mutant features named. New step 14a battery_sealed_objects for BD-261. Pre- and post-close bundles with distinct keys and verify verdicts. Acceptance extended.

Tests moved to crates/frob-conformance/tests/qual_invariants.rs; a frob-arena test that starts frobd would be an upward dev-dependency. Title and labels changed to match. Planted violations are nc-<nnnn> branches with control records. The e2e step is N24b-24's step 5a, with its command.

U28c request applied: at the M3 first-use admission of fs-voi, the probe adds N28c-28's admission test (EVSI 0.00131 and 0.00550, zero-value stop), and the bead completes the fs-voi row of docs/adr/OPEN-ATEL-3.md with branch, reason and receipt hash under N28c-28's decision and switch-over rules. record_gate command added. Dep N28c-28 (no cycle).

Fixed the receipt: it claimed cluster identifiers and aggregate statistics, which BD-259 forbids; it now carries BD-259's fields only. The control moves to the absolute world: on the paired no-signal pair the unblinded harness is caught in only about 3% of campaigns, so the demo would have failed. Expected first false promotion near request 76. Added the administrator's open and close steps (a0, i), 803/841 for step g, and tests.

Count and control are read on the absolute world, with the paired worlds reported. The decide script no longer cites the M5 auditor replay (BD-383) at M3: it reads BD-260's record and eval.ledger. The smoke run opens and closes campaigns with keys.

requests.what: eval.ledger row needs four admin actions. open and close (N24b-15) take capabilities eval:read and qual:admin and their own idempotency key. Options: --task, --baseline-class, --world-family, --slug, --alpha, --clusters-per-request, --tier-plan, --max-requests, --level-schedule, and --kind battery with --label; MCP property action. seal and read-sealed (BD-261) apply to battery campaigns. The row also needs the claim-family input; Implemented by should add BD-261. eval.ledger refusals should add 720, 803, 886, campaign-already-open, qualification-undecided and campaign-not-open. eval.qualify refusals should add 825 (N24b-16's D4-evidence check), 720, 701 and the symbolic campaign-state names. Recheck 561: the lane raises 533 through study::admit for a paired D4 arm.

Register symbolic qualification-undecided (8xx, exit 3, N24b-15): opening a non-synthetic claim family while config/qualification.toml has decided: false. Widen 567's Arena trigger to any world set a caller names as the confirmation sample (hard, covering, search-selected, development addresses; N24b-16). Use FROB-REF-803 (exit 7) for the conflicting-idempotency-key case of eval.qualify, as BD-259, N24b-16 and KA-763 do. Then drop the '7 when the same idempotency key carries different content' variant from 841's row and from exit_code_by_family, so one situation raises one code.

MR-13's sites: mr:MR-13@host is bound by N24b-18 and mr:MR-13@daemon by N24a-34. Its mutation is one nc feature in frob-arena with two branches (derivation of N24b-17, level of N24b-15), written by N24b-18. The '>99% of campaigns' acceptance holds on N24b-18's absolute-above world (0.9987); on the paired worlds the mutant reaches only 0.034 and 0.126.
CERT-07's broken-certifier row justifies >99% with 1 − 0.95^500. No rule here has size exactly 5%. Use 1 − (1 − 0.01319)^500 = 0.9987 on the absolute no-signal world (N24b-18, BD-260).

The firewall now holds battery sealed objects (BD-261). Open the battery campaign with frob eval ledger --open --kind battery --label <name> (N24b-15). Write keys with the seal action and read them before close only with read-sealed under qual:admin. The interim store-outside posture can go once BD-261 lands.

The test campaign for B12 is opened and closed with N24b-15's admin actions (frob eval ledger --open/--close with keys). While OPEN-ARENA-3 is undecided, a non-synthetic claim family is refused with qualification-undecided.

notes: Unchanged: N24c-13 and GB-29, whose arithmetic was rechecked with scipy. Checked against the plan: the U24b request to BD-260 was applied with corrected paired control expectations.
